mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT ServiceName FROM quasar_tracing.spans WHERE Timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 3 DAY ORDER BY ServiceName

SELECT DISTINCT root_name FROM ( SELECT argMin(SpanName, Timestamp) AS root_name FROM quasar_tracing.spans WHERE Timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 3 DAY GROUP BY TraceId ) WHERE root_name != '' ORDER BY root_name

SELECT DISTINCT ResourceAttributes['deployment.environment.name'] AS env FROM quasar_tracing.spans WHERE ResourceAttributes['deployment.environment.name'] != '' AND Timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 3 DAY ORDER BY env

SELECT DISTINCT value FROM ( SELECT ResourceAttributes['service.namespace'] AS value FROM quasar_tracing.spans WHERE Timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 3 DAY UNION ALL SELECT if(indexOf(mapKeys(ResourceAttributes), 'k8s.namespace.name') = 0, '', arrayElement(mapValues(ResourceAttributes), indexOf(mapKeys(ResourceAttributes), 'k8s.namespace.name'))) AS value FROM quasar_tracing.spans WHERE Timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 3 DAY ) WHERE value != '' ORDER BY value
